newsitem.title: USA: Triton writes off Argentina acreage.
newsitem.headline: Triton writes off Argentina acreage.

text.p: Triton Energy Ltd said Friday its Argentina acreage does not meet the company's primary objective and it has elected to take a noncash charge against its fourth-quarter 1996 financial results of about $43 million pretax or some $38 million after taxes.
The company said it expects the charge will result in a fourth-quarter loss but anticipates full-year results will be improved from 1995's.
It said the charge represents all costs associated with the company's Argentine operation during the past 12 years.

After a review of recently obtained technical information, Triton explained, it has determined the company's acreage portfolio in Argentina, although commercially prospective, does not meet Triton's primary objective of exploring for sizable oil and gas reserves.
